confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: C0006 shows a significant set-level technical association with CT scanner model (Sensation 64 over-represented), providing a plausible competing technical explanation that could partly drive its separation.
confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: C0006 has a notable CT scanner-model imbalance that could confound its definition; the VHL-wild-type molecular signal is distinctive but the technical association warrants caution.
limitations: Confounder test covers only available technical fields.
Association does not prove causation of the partition.

known_label_echo.statistical_interpretation: Overlap between the partition and TCGA stage/grade labels is very low (ARI near zero for both), indicating the partition does not echo stage or grade.

reports.statistical_interpretation: C0006 shows a significant, coherent WXS signal of VHL wild-type status (complete absence of VHL mutation) with PBRM1 depletion, a distinctive pattern. CNV shows no adjusted-significant features.
reports.medical_interpretation: C0006 is characterized by a VHL-wild-type, PBRM1-depleted molecular signature, a biologically distinctive pattern. CNV provides no corroboration but no contradiction.
limitations: CNV features non-significant after correction.
